sections.h1: How a B2B AI SaaS lifted *MRR by 31%* and cut churn by 24% in 90 days
sections.lead: Steady traffic, but revenue was leaking through poor free-to-paid conversion and high onboarding churn. By re-aligning the value proposition, shortening time-to-value and redesigning a key feature page, we delivered measurable growth within weeks.

problem.lead: Steady traffic, but revenue was leaking through poor free-to-paid conversion and high onboarding churn.
items: **Value proposition mismatch:** the homepage talked about complex features instead of the concrete outcome, so visitors left within seconds.
**Slow time-to-value:** a steep onboarding curve kept new sign-ups from reaching their first "Aha!" moment.

steps.p: We rewrote the homepage messaging around what the product does for its users and handed restructured mockups to the dev team to cut drop-offs and speed up free-to-paid conversion.
Iterative UX/UI mockups simplified onboarding and the core feature interfaces. New users reached their first "Aha!" faster: more free-to-paid conversions and up to 40% less churn on key segments.
We analyzed behavior data on the main revenue page, found the drop-off points and delivered CRO mockups in 3 days. The dev team shipped them the next day: +30% conversions in 4 days.

sections.h2: Frequently asked questions about *this case study*
Want to spot the leaks in your *funnel and onboarding?*
sections.p: If your product has steady traffic but conversion or retention is lagging, let's review your flow together.

faq.q: What results did this SaaS case study achieve?
a: +31% monthly recurring revenue within 4 days of launch, −24% churn over 90 days (up to −40% on key user segments) and +30% conversions on the core revenue feature page within 4 days.

faq.q: What did you change to get these results?
a: Three things: we re-aligned the homepage value proposition around the user outcome, we simplified onboarding so users reach their first "Aha!" faster, and we redesigned the high-intent feature page based on behavior data.

faq.q: Can you do the same for my SaaS?
a: Results depend on each product, but the method applies. We start with a user-journey teardown to spot the leaks in your funnel, onboarding and key feature pages. [Book a 15-minute teardown](@contact).
